issuer: the Coordinación General de Movilidad y Transporte of the State of Morelos

licence.name: licencia de conducir tipo A, automovilista

note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Morelos Consejería Jurídica's legal framework (marcojuridico.morelos.gob.mx). The Ley de Movilidad, Transporte y Seguridad Vial del Estado de Morelos (Periódico Oficial 6493 Extraordinaria, 25 November 2025, in force 26 November 2025; text as last reformed 23 April 2026) makes the Coordinación General the only authority in the state that issues licences (Art. 145), classes the private car's licence as Tipo A, Automovilista (Art. 146), and requires a first applicant to be of age, save the minors' permits (Art. 148): the Código Familiar of Morelos (Art. 5) puts the age of majority at eighteen, so the licence is held from 18 (the provisional permit for those over sixteen and under eighteen, of one year at most (Arts. 153 and 154), isn't the licence and isn't held). The Ley General de Hacienda del Estado de Morelos (text as last reformed 3 February 2026), Article 84, fraction XIII, prices the issue of a driving licence in UMA: the automovilista's for one year 4.90, three years 6.40, five years 7.90, and a permanent licence for private cars 12.30 (with 3.60 more for a first licence); the fee held is the one-year licence's, 4.90 UMA at INEGI's daily UMA for 2026 ($117.31), $574.82, worked out here (the law gives the fee in UMA, not pesos; no rounding rule was read). The state's licence page (digital.morelos.gob.mx) renders by script and wasn't read. No identity card and no exchange list are held. The fee is set in UMA (the federal unit of account, revalued each year); the lead took out the peso figure worked here from INEGI's 2026 value (2026-10-30), a conversion no source publishes and that goes stale with the unit, so the fee stands null until the form holds a fee in an index unit.
